title: Winning, one minute left
text: Your team is 2–1 up with a minute to go. You have the ball near their corner flag.
tip: Know the score and the time. They change the best decision.

options.text: Shield the ball by the corner flag
options.why: Every second the ball stays there is a second they can't attack you.
Nobody is there, so you'd hand them the ball and a chance to attack.
Keeps the ball, but brings play back towards your own goal.
